# Aomi

> Aomi is the execution harness for onchain AI. Plain-language instructions become real transactions — EVM and Solana behind one interface — through one pipeline: build, simulate, sign, broadcast. Non-custodial: the agent proposes, the user's own key signs. Aomi is also a hosted platform ("Vercel for crypto agents"): you compose your APIs, skills, and prompt as a plugin, the runtime loads it dynamically, and your users reach the agent via widget, Telegram, or Discord.

## Use Aomi
- [Introduction](https://aomi.dev/docs/index): what Aomi is, demo clips, and the architecture.
- [Portal](https://aomi.dev/docs/trade/portal): the hosted chat at chat.aomi.dev — connect a wallet and trade by chat.
- [Agents with MCP](https://aomi.dev/docs/guides/mcp): connect Claude Code, Cursor, or any MCP client to the Aomi server.
- [Client CLI](https://aomi.dev/docs/reference/client-cli): install the aomi command, chat, simulate, and sign from the terminal — every command, flag, and environment variable.

## Trade on Aomi
- [Overview](https://aomi.dev/docs/trade/index): how Aomi executes on-chain trades.
- [How execution works](https://aomi.dev/docs/trade/execution): the simulate-before-sign trade flow.

## Build on Aomi
- [Overview](https://aomi.dev/docs/build/overview): why plugins exist, what an App is, and the path to ship one.
- [Quickstart](https://aomi.dev/docs/build/quickstart): zero to a deployed App.
- [Aomi App](https://aomi.dev/docs/build/plugins/aomi-app): the crate layout, aomi.toml, preamble, and tools.
- [Rust SDK](https://aomi.dev/docs/build/plugins/rust-sdk): the DynAomiTool trait and the dyn_aomi_app! macro.
- [Custom tools](https://aomi.dev/docs/build/plugins/custom-tools): add your own tools with DynAomiTool.
- [Evals and testing](https://aomi.dev/docs/build/plugins/evals-and-testing): test a plugin before it ships.
- [aomi-run](https://aomi.dev/docs/build/toolchain/aomi-run): the local dev runtime — chat with your plugin before shipping.
- [aomi-build](https://aomi.dev/docs/build/toolchain/aomi-build): connect, deploy, and activate from the terminal.
- [The Developer Platform](https://aomi.dev/docs/build/developer-platform): create, deploy, and operate Apps from the browser at build.aomi.dev.
- [Put your App on Telegram](https://aomi.dev/docs/build/telegram): turn a deployed App into a hosted Telegram bot.
- [Common errors](https://aomi.dev/docs/build/common-errors): the errors a builder hits and the fixes.

- [Widget installation](https://aomi.dev/docs/guides/widget/widget-installation): props, compound API, and theming.
- [Headless library](https://aomi.dev/docs/guides/widget/customization#build-a-headless-ui): the @aomi-labs/react library and the AomiClient.

## Concepts
- [How it works](https://aomi.dev/docs/concepts/transaction-pipeline): the request flow.
- [Architecture](https://aomi.dev/docs/concepts/architecture): the public App and runtime model.
- [Permission model](https://aomi.dev/docs/concepts/permission-model): signing modes, the permit ceremony, guards — fail-closed everywhere.
- [Accounts and wallets](https://aomi.dev/docs/concepts/accounts-and-wallets): one user, many wallets; delegation as data.
- [Multi-threading](https://aomi.dev/docs/concepts/multi-threading): durable parent and child threads with controlled authority.
- [Asynchronous tasks](https://aomi.dev/docs/concepts/asynchronous-tasks): detached, scheduled, recurring, and condition-triggered runs.
- [Payments](https://aomi.dev/docs/concepts/payments): price tools in credits, settle over x402.
- [EVM](https://aomi.dev/docs/concepts/chains/evm) / [SVM](https://aomi.dev/docs/concepts/chains/svm): the multi-chain specification.
- [Glossary](https://aomi.dev/docs/concepts/glossary): the terms.

## Reference
- [HTTP API](https://aomi.dev/docs/reference/api-reference): the backend HTTP surface.
- [Simulation](https://aomi.dev/docs/reference/simulation-reference): simulate-before-sign.

- [Apps and authentication](https://aomi.dev/docs/reference/apps-and-authentication): App keys and scoping.
